classification.locality: Local installation under dist/host-listener; no cross-player telemetry or user save identities in trained class keys
separate_evidence: replay-unique outcome-evidence fingerprint per object class/action/domain
classification.utility_requirement: At least three distinct reviewed helpful evidence fingerprints and >=75% helpful among unique same-domain evidence; legacy aggregate counts alone never promote
classification.unknown: Recorded, not promoted; cross-domain harmful reviewed effects veto otherwise helpful candidates until separately reviewed tradeoff policy

sequencing: Monotonic 1-based seq per unique explicit session; only byte-identical most-recent retransmission is idempotent; contradictory/stale sequence or backward event clock denied; menu and selection bind exact fresh capture; post-action outcome requires later distinct capture
recommendation: Only after an exact current menu observation matching session, patch, object, class, capture and action list within 30 seconds
player_first: Any player_active or player_queue_present denies catalog recommendation; no queue cancel permitted

privacy.storage: atomic bounded opt-in local JSON projection

scope.current: Existing semantically calibrated user/host interaction observers submit events via active session. The catalog does not itself discover game signals or instrument Windows input.
required_for_live_complete: certified local game menu sensor and player/host event adapter
queue integration behind cooperative control gates
P08 disposable game trial with review
scope.bi002: Hunger A/B 5+5 rollback and maintainer review remains current parent gate

review_integrity.store: Bounded fingerprints of reviewed outcome evidence refs (not raw evidence refs) and last accepted event per session
review_integrity.legacy_compatibility: Existing catalogs without fingerprints remain readable and preserve counts, but historical counts without replay-provenanced reviews do not authorize recommendation
review_integrity.replay: Only exact last accepted normalized event may be replayed idempotently; older or conflicting payload rejected
review_integrity.duplicate: Repeated reviewed evidence for same class/action/domain contributes at most one training sample, even across observer sessions
review_integrity.conflicting_outcomes: If a candidate's reviewed effects contain harm to any other domain, abstain pending separate tradeoff policy
review_integrity.capacity: Evidence cap returns explicit fail-closed abstention; never silently evict reviewed positive or negative evidence
